summary: Implemented the engine-free feature. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver: save, save_batch, finalize) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver: static _create_file_basename, save, save_batch). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, leaving the GIF helpers unchanged. Changed the nifti_writer default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters over the savers and plot function; the TensorBoard handler gained an index parameter before max_channels. Renamed output_path to output_dir in examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Choices: ClassificationSaver registers a _finalize(engine) wrapper because ignite passes the engine to completion hooks; NiftiSaver also advances the item index. Nothing was run or imported, per the instructions, so all tests are unverified. Nothing is committed.
